item.title: 'RIP Brother': METALLICA’s Rob Trujillo Shares Heartbreaking Tribute Ahead of Ozzy Osbourne’s Funeral
item.description: Metallica bassist Rob Trujillo has posted a personal message as he prepares to attend Ozzy Osbourne’s funeral. The service will be held on July 30 in Birmingham, England.
